exercises.instruction: Join one line from each list in the scene to make a sentence with to … .
exercises.scene:
🔧 The two lists — make one sentence from each pair:
List A · sentence openings | List B · the purpose
I shouted | I wanted to be nearer my friends
I opened the box | I wanted to warn people of the danger
I moved to a new apartment | I wanted to see what was in it
I couldn’t find a knife | I wanted to report the accident
I called the police | I wanted to find out if they had any rooms free
I called the hotel | I wanted someone to help me with my work
I employed an assistant | I wanted to chop the onions

answers: I opened the box to see what was in it.

items.cue: Use the list A line: I moved to a new apartment
answers: I moved to a new apartment to be nearer my friends.

items.cue: Use the list A line: I couldn’t find a knife
answers: I couldn’t find a knife to chop the onions.
I couldn’t find a knife to chop the onions with.

items.cue: Use the list A line: I called the police
answers: I called the police to report the accident.

items.cue: Use the list A line: I called the hotel
answers: I called the hotel to find out if they had any rooms free.

items.cue: Use the list A line: I employed an assistant
answers: I employed an assistant to help me with my work.

exercises.instruction: Complete each sentence using to + a suitable verb.

parts: all the things I have to do.
I came home by taxi. I didn’t have the energy
Can you give me a bag
There will be a meeting next week
I saw Helen at the party, but I didn’t have a chance
I need some new clothes. I don’t have anything nice
They’ve passed their exams. They’re going to have a party
I can’t do all this work alone. I need somebody
Why are you so scared? There’s nothing
He’s very old. He needs somebody
I wish we had a garden

exercises.instruction: Make one sentence from two, using so that.

items.prompt: I wore warm clothes. I didn’t want to get cold.
answers: I wore warm clothes so that I wouldn’t get cold.
I wore warm clothes so that I wouldn’t be cold.

items.prompt: I gave Mark my phone number. I wanted him to be able to contact me.
answers: I gave Mark my phone number so that he could contact me.
I gave Mark my phone number so that he would be able to contact me.

items.prompt: We spoke very quietly. We didn’t want anybody else to hear us.
answers: We spoke very quietly so that nobody else would hear us.
We spoke very quietly so that nobody else could hear us.
We spoke very quietly so that nobody else would be able to hear us.

items.prompt: Please arrive early. We want to be able to start the meeting on time.
answers: Please arrive early so that we can start the meeting on time.
Please arrive early so that we’ll be able to start the meeting on time.

items.prompt: We made a list of things to do. We didn’t want to forget anything.
answers: We made a list of things to do so that we wouldn’t forget anything.

items.prompt: I slowed down. I wanted the car behind me to be able to overtake.
answers: I slowed down so that the car behind me could overtake.
I slowed down so that the car behind me would be able to overtake.
